_meta.indication: Treatment of patients with metastatic colorectal cancer who have been previously treated with fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF biological therapy, and, if RAS wild-type, an anti-EGFR therapy.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center study of TAS-102 plus best supportive care (BSC) versus placebo plus BSC; 2:1 randomization stratified by KRAS status, time since first metastasis, and geographical region.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with metastatic colorectal cancer refractory to standard chemotherapies, previously treated with fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based chemotherapy, an anti-VEGF biological therapy, and an anti-EGFR therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was overall survival (OS); secondary endpoints included progression free survival (PFS) and overall response rate (ORR).
pivotal_trials.result: Median OS 7.1 months (TAS-102) vs 5.3 months (placebo); HR 0.68 (95% CI 0.58, 0.81); p<0.0001.

nct_ctgov.title: Study of TAS-102 in Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Refractory to Standard Chemotherapies

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%) were anemia, neutropenia, asthenia/fatigue, nausea, thrombocytopenia, decreased appetite, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and pyrexia. Severe/life-threatening myelosuppression (Grade 3-4) included anemia (18%), neutropenia (38%), thrombocytopenia (5%) and febrile neutropenia (3.8%); one patient (0.2%) died due to neutropenic infection.
target_moa: LONSURF is a combination of trifluridine, a thymidine-based nucleoside analog, and tipiracil, a thymidine phosphorylase inhibitor. Following uptake into cancer cells, trifluridine is incorporated into DNA, interferes with DNA synthesis and inhibits cell proliferation; tipiracil increases trifluridine exposure by inhibiting its metabolism by thymidine phosphorylase.
modality: Small molecule (oral fixed-combination of nucleoside analog trifluridine and thymidine phosphorylase inhibitor tipiracil)

rems.type: REMS are not required to ensure safe use of Lonsurf in the indicated population.

advisory_committee.vote: The NDA was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the safety profile was acceptable and the application did not raise significant public health questions.

description.text: Added new indication for adult patients with metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma previously treated with at least two prior lines of chemotherapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma previously treated with at least two prior lines of chemotherapy that included a fluoropyrimidine, a platinum, either a taxane or irinotecan, and if appropriate, HER2/neu-targeted therapy.
